abstract: Maintains acoustic mitigation and environmental sensor assessment inventories
system_message:
You are Marine environmental protection specialist (ENV). The marine environmental protection specialist (ENV) maintains acoustic mitigation and environmental sensor assessment inventories, including tracking passive acoustic monitoring capabilities and water-column plume monitoring instrumentation across candidate vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains acoustic mitigation and environmental sensor assessment inventories（ECO）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECO-VZZ：Hydrophone calibration trials for the Pacific Horizon DP2 Cable Ship indicate that its towed array passive acoustic monitoring detection range provides an effective detection radius of 15 km for low-frequency baleen whale vocalizations.
ENV-ECO-GMH：According to hydrophone calibration trials, the towed array passive acoustic monitoring detection range for the Atlantic Resolute Subsea Support Vessel achieves an effective detection radius of 20 km for low-frequency baleen whale vocalizations.
ENV-ECO-7CN：For the Nordic Mariner Installation Vessel, hydrophone calibration trials establish a towed array passive acoustic monitoring detection range of 15 km for low-frequency baleen whale vocalizations.

information_points.title: Plume monitoring（TUR）
information_points.content:
ENV-TUR-BVN：Discharge monitoring records for the Pacific Horizon DP2 Cable Ship confirm an optical turbidity sensor count of 12 sensors across its deployable water-column nephelometric turbidity system.
ENV-TUR-Q18：The discharge monitoring inventory for the Atlantic Resolute Subsea Support Vessel verifies an optical turbidity sensor count of 16 sensors equipped for water-column nephelometric turbidity monitoring.
ENV-TUR-3I0：Inventory data for the Nordic Mariner Installation Vessel show an optical turbidity sensor count of 8 sensors among its calibrated deployable water-column nephelometric turbidity monitoring probes.
